Market data (M03, M05).

```text
synthetic  reproducible generators with documented, planted properties
loaders    CSV and free-API loaders for real data
samples/   fictional headlines and filings used by the NLP labs (package data)
```

### `cfmat.data.loaders`

Loading real market data from files and free APIs (M03, M05).

| Name | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `download_prices` | `def download_prices(ticker: str, start: str = '2018-01-01', end: str \| None = None) -> pd.DataFrame` | Download split/dividend-adjusted daily OHLCV with yfinance. |
| `load_ohlcv_csv` | `def load_ohlcv_csv(path: str \| Path) -> pd.DataFrame` | Read a CSV with a date column and OHLCV columns (any capitalisation). |
